notes: Denmark storefront (da-dk locale, SFCC, direct HTTP fetch worked throughout). Found and inspected every clearance/outlet-shaped candidate: (1) /da-dk/outlet - a 301/302 dead redirect chain (/da-dk/outlet -> /da-dk/tilbud/outlet -> /da-dk homepage), i.e. a retired page, not a live listing. (2) The site's own search (form action /da-dk/soeg?q=) for 'outlet' 302-redirects to /da-dk/udsalg, which itself 302-redirects straight to the homepage - also dead. Searches for 'restlager' and 'clearance' returned the soft-404 template (0 product tiles), not genuine results. (3) The sitemap (da-dk/sitemap_0.xml) DOES list real, live listing pages under a '/da-dk/udsalg/*' URL prefix ('udsalg' = Danish for 'sale'): /da-dk/udsalg/alle-produkter ('all products'), /da-dk/udsalg/bolig (Home), /da-dk/udsalg/bestik (Cutlery), and /da-dk/udsalg/julepynt (Christmas decor). All four were opened and inspected: page titles are 'Georg Jensen ... | Summer Sale 2026 | Spar op til 50%' and the on-page hero copy states 'Summer Sale tilbud og spar op til 50% på udvalgte designs ... Tilbuddet gælder til og med den 20.07.2026' ("The offer is valid through 20 July 2026") - i.e. an explicit end-dated, dated (2026), seasonal promotional discount campaign, not a permanent outlet/clearance/end-of-line merchandising concept. This is exactly the Udsalg-means-Sale trap flagged in the task brief: the URL segment literally means 'sale', and the page itself is a temporary Summer Sale, not Clearance. Per the Clearance-vs-Sale rule (generic temporary promotional sale with an explicit expiry date = exclude), these are NOT recorded as Clearance rows. Also noted in the sitemap and excluded on the same grounds: /da-dk/black-friday/alle-tilbud (Black Friday campaign), /da-dk/tilbud/koeb-2-spar-20 ('buy 2 save 20%' promo), /da-dk/tilbud/saet-til-hjemmet (bundle promo) - all temporary percent-off campaigns, no permanence signal, no 'outlet'/'restlager'/'final sale'/'end of line' language on any of them. Conclusion: no genuine permanent Clearance/Outlet PLP currently exists on this site; only a dead retired Outlet page and a live but clearly temporary, dated Summer Sale 2026 campaign, which is correctly excluded.
